name: LensVision Macro 100mm f/2.8
description: Step into the miniature world with the LensVision Macro 100mm f/2.8. This specialty lens is engineered to reveal details invisible to the naked eye, offering true 1:1 life-size magnification at its minimum focusing distance. The 100mm focal length provides a comfortable working distance from your subject, ideal for photographing insects or other skittish creatures without disturbing them. Optically, it is exceptionally sharp, delivering crisp details and beautiful color rendition that make small subjects come to life. While its primary purpose is macro, this lens also doubles as an outstanding portrait lens, with the f/2.8 aperture producing a shallow depth of field and pleasing bokeh. The internal focusing mechanism means the lens barrel does not extend, preventing accidental bumps against your subject. For anyone passionate about capturing the intricate beauty of the small world, from flowers to insects to product details, this macro lens is an essential and rewarding tool. Features: 1:1 Life-Size Magnification Ratio, 100mm focal length provides excellent working distance, Exceptionally sharp optics, Doubles as a superb portrait lens, Internal focusing design. Advantages: True 1:1 macro capability; Very high image sharpness; Versatile for both macro and portraiture. Considerations: Autofocus can be slow when 'hunting' in macro range; Lacks image stabilization. Best for: Niche photographers specializing in macro, as well as product photographers and portrait shooters looking for a sharp prime lens.
